baseline_models.focus_anchor: The city, the threatened expulsion, and the repeated ع ز ز at words 7 and 11 form a dispute over who can define membership and rank.
baseline_models.mechanism: The boast treats the city as a bounded possession whose locally dominant party may purge the weaker. The corrective distribution of might to God, the Messenger, and believers replaces possession-by-coercion with a relational source of reinforcement: civic control can be claimed, but might is not generated by controlling the gate.

activation_trace.role: The gathered city supplies the bounded civic body over which the speakers claim disposal power.
Passing something outside a containing place supplies the proposed mechanism for policing that civic body.
Dominance and overpowering supply the speakers' competitive definition of might.
Reinforcement supplies the corrective model in which might strengthens a linked community rather than licenses a purge.
Settled security and trust make believers participants in that relational reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: A faction falsely predicts which social class will be expelled from the city.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contests the faction's jurisdictional model itself: a gate can be controlled by coercion, but the might that constitutes the community is sourced through God, messenger, and trusting members.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed superlatives built from ع ز ز and ذ ل ل are followed by the inclusion of believers within might.
baseline_models.mechanism: The boast compresses all social posture into a hard binary: dominance counts as honor and yielding counts as humiliation. The branch field permits another axis. Solidity can be cohesion, while ذ ل ل can be gentle tractability without abasement; secure trust can therefore coexist with softness. The correction breaks the speakers' equation of harshness with strength.

activation_trace.role: Firm ground and cohesion supply a non-theatrical form of strength.
Gentleness without degradation separates softness of manner from conquered status.
Tractability after difficulty supplies productive yielding as an alternative to humiliation.
Inner security explains how a gentle community need not be an abject one.

changed_reading.before: The verse reverses which camp is socially strong and which is humiliated.
changed_reading.after: The verse also refuses the boast's metric: trusting gentleness may belong to genuine cohesion, while coercive hardness need not be might at all.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah begins with their saying, embeds a conditional return, predicts an expulsion, and then corrects their knowledge and allocation of might.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their utterance is not mere description but an attempt to adjudicate rank and impose a future. Yet رجع can carry the return of speech to its speaker, while خروج can mark departure from an origin or allegiance. The correction makes the proposed rule self-applying: the boast that classifies another as outside rebounds as evidence that its speaker is outside the true alignment of might, without forcing a single literal identity for the expelled party.

activation_trace.role: Speech used as judgment over another supplies the boast's attempted performative verdict.
Attributing what is not so keeps the threatened future open as fabrication rather than settled fact.
A reply or word returning to its source supplies the rebound of the speakers' own criterion.
Departure from an origin, group, or obedience allows expulsion to register as relational disalignment as well as physical removal.
Uncovering reality supplies the corrective exposure that makes the attempted verdict rebound.

changed_reading.before: The opening merely quotes a mistaken forecast.
changed_reading.after: The quoted forecast is also a failed act of classification whose rule returns upon its authors and reveals their own departure from the order they claim to command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final subject is the hypocrites, whose root inventory sits directly beside the denial of knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hidden-exit architecture of ن ف ق supplies more than duplicity: one visible opening and another concealed outlet prevent stable orientation. By contrast, ع ل م includes both disclosure and a distinguishing mark. Their failure to know where might lies is therefore a structural inability to remain aligned with a visible relation; they continually preserve an unacknowledged way out.

activation_trace.role: A through-tunnel with an outlet supplies unstable, passage-based belonging.
A displayed entrance and concealed exit supply the asymmetry between public affiliation and private escape.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the recognition they lack.
A visible distinguishing mark supplies an orientation signal that their divided passage fails to follow.
Being sent outward supplies an open, directed movement that contrasts with concealed egress.

changed_reading.before: The hypocrites are simply uninformed about the true owner of might.
changed_reading.after: Their ignorance is enacted by their mode of belonging: a concealed-exit posture cannot stably read or inhabit the openly marked direction of might.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah separates an impressive spoken testimony from the knowledge and counter-testimony that adjudicate it. This converts the correction in 63:8 from a rival slogan into a verdict about evidentiary authority: voiced certainty cannot allocate might when the speakers' displayed account misreports their condition.

activation_trace.role: Utterance brought into speech supplies the public declaration under review.
Testimony stated from knowledge supplies the standard their declaration imitates but does not meet.
A garment whose appearance lies about its condition supplies the mismatch between polished display and reality.
Known disclosure supplies the superior evidentiary position from which their speech is judged.
The focus boast uses speech to rule upon another, making it the later instance of the same failed testimony regime.
The disputed dominance is the object their unreliable speech attempts to assign.

structural_cues: 63:1 and 63:8 repeat saying, Messenger, God, hypocrites, and knowing, while 63:1 explicitly stages testimony and its falsification.
The focus correction follows the quoted boast inside the same ayah, reproducing a claim-and-adjudication sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel speech, knowledge, testimony, and falsity; I infer that the earlier evidentiary scene governs how the later correction functions. A live alternative is that 63:1 exposes only sincerity while 63:8 independently corrects political power.

changed_reading.before: The divine clause counters one political assertion with another.
changed_reading.after: The divine clause is a counter-testimony that strips the boast of standing before it even settles the identity of the socially strong.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oaths become a protective screen while the path is blocked. Read against the focus ayah, the expulsion threat belongs to a gatekeeping system: public speech fortifies insiders, redirects movement, and threatens removal, even though the speakers themselves are figured by a hidden outlet. Their claim to guard the civic boundary is destabilized by the concealed boundary crossing built into their own designation.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the voiced material from which the defensive perimeter is made.
A protective shield turns speech into cover rather than disclosure.
Turning others away supplies active control over access and direction.
The traversable road supplies the route that their shielded speech obstructs.
A visible entrance paired with a concealed outlet exposes the gatekeepers as covert boundary crossers.
Forced movement outside becomes the overt boundary action threatened by the covertly doubled speakers.

structural_cues: 63:2 orders oath, shield, and obstruction; 63:8 orders boast, return, and forced exit.
Both scenes use speech to manage who may move safely through a bounded social space.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defensive oaths, blocked travel, hidden exits, and threatened expulsion; I infer one gatekeeping technology linking them. The alternative is that the shield is only protection from accountability and need not imply civic perimeter control.

changed_reading.before: The expulsion claim is an isolated burst of factional arrogance.
changed_reading.after: It is the overt edge of a broader shield-and-obstruction system whose operators claim the gate while preserving a hidden exit for themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of belief, covering, impressed seal, heart, and failed understanding materializes the focus clause 'they do not know.' Their epistemic failure is not a blank absence but a feedback history: reversal is stamped into the receptive center until the public marks of might can no longer be read.

activation_trace.role: Covering the truth supplies the active occlusion that follows their prior belief.
A stamp that seals and forms an image supplies durable inscription rather than momentary confusion.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal of the very center meant to receive disclosure.
Comprehension supplies the capacity lost at the end of the sequence.
The distinguishing sign they fail to read anchors the sequence back to the focus denial of knowledge.

structural_cues: 63:3 gives a temporal sequence: belief, then covering, then sealing, then no comprehension.
63:8 ends its reversal of claimed rank with another cognition failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered reversal, sealing, heart, and incomprehension; I infer a hardening feedback loop that explains the focus misrecognition. A live alternative is that the seal is a consequence stated without a psychological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their error about might could be corrected by supplying the missing fact.
changed_reading.after: Their error is a sealed reading practice produced by prior reversal; the true allocation is visible, yet their receptive center has been turned away from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding portrait first manufactures stature through attractive appearance and bodily bulk, then reveals inert timber that must lean on support and startles at every cry. This activates the focus branch of عزة as cohesion: genuine firmness is not the same as visual hardness. The party calling itself mightier is a supported facade whose acoustic panic contradicts its monumental pose.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance and spectacle supply the surface on which their strength is first inferred.
Beauty in the observer's eye supplies the attraction that makes the facade persuasive.
Bodily magnitude supplies the apparent mass mistaken for social might.
Inert timber supplies hard material without self-directed life or agency.
Leaning dependence supplies the borrowed support hidden by the upright display.
The frightening cry supplies a small acoustic test under which the facade reveals insecurity.
Cohesive firmness supplies the focus standard against which rigid but dependent display is measured.

structural_cues: 63:4 moves from admired bodies and listened-to speech to propped wood and fear of every shout.
63:8 later sets a claimed comparative might against a corrected source of might.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bulk, attractive visibility, hard material, external support, and panic; I infer that these jointly falsify the speakers' metric of might. The wood image may alternatively target lifeless comprehension rather than political strength, and both readings can coexist.

changed_reading.before: The speakers possess real worldly strength but misidentify its ultimate owner.
changed_reading.after: Even their worldly strength is suspect: it is staged bulk and rigid appearance held up from outside, while true might behaves as unborrowed cohesion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers confidently imagine returning to the city but refuse the offered movement toward repair: a call upward is met by twisted heads, aversion, and self-magnification. Their geographic return is therefore hollow. The focus رجع becomes double: they can re-enter a place while refusing to return from the posture that has put them outside the true order of might.

activation_trace.role: The call to rise supplies an offered directional movement toward the Messenger and repair.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the restorative destination they decline.
Turning aside without looking supplies the bodily anti-return.
Aversion and diversion supply persistence away from the offered route.
Self-magnifying pride supplies the false vertical status that blocks the call upward.
Returning from a wrong or affair supplies the ethical return absent beneath their promised geographic return.
Coming to the city supplies the merely geographic arrival they confidently anticipate.

structural_cues: 63:5 commands a coming-toward movement, then describes head-twisting and active refusal.
63:6 repeats the forgiveness question and closes the route to guidance after that refusal.
63:8 uses an emphatic conditional return to the city.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies geographic return, an offered restorative approach, and bodily turning away; I infer an ethical-spatial contrast between two kinds of return. The alternative is to keep رجع entirely geographic and treat the earlier refusal only as character evidence.

changed_reading.before: Returning to the city is a neutral logistical condition for the threat.
changed_reading.after: Their confident return to place exposes their deeper non-return: they can re-enter the city while remaining turned away from repair, Messenger, and the source of might.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding policy withholds outward expenditure so that those around the Messenger will break apart. The focus threat is thus a second stage of the same operation: first engineer dispersal by constricting provision, then narrate the resulting exit as proof of superiority. Divine ownership of stores breaks the assumed causal chain, and the repeated ن ف ق sharply opposes sustaining open outflow to the concealed outlet of hypocrisy.

activation_trace.role: Money going outward supplies the resource flow they attempt to arrest in order to produce social movement.
The concealed-exit image makes the agents who block open expenditure themselves bearers of covert outflow.
A gathering breaking apart supplies the intended social result of the embargo.
Secured stores supply the resource base whose ownership invalidates their scarcity premise.
Movement outside the city supplies the threatened spatial result of the preceding dispersal policy.
Reinforcement supplies an alternative economy of might that sustains the gathering rather than manufacturing its fracture.

structural_cues: 63:7 immediately precedes 63:8 and pairs a command to stop spending with the desired dispersal of those around the Messenger.
Both ayat answer a human control claim with a God-owned resource: treasuries in 63:7 and might in 63:8.
The repeated hypocrite designation shares the same root as expenditure in 63:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld spending, intended dispersal, divine stores, and threatened expulsion; I infer a causal strategy from economic constriction to civic removal. A live alternative is that 63:7 and 63:8 preserve two parallel boasts without one operationally causing the other.

changed_reading.before: The boast predicts expulsion by direct political force.
changed_reading.after: The boast crowns a scarcity operation: constrict provision, make the Messenger's people disperse, then misrecognize engineered vulnerability as evidence of the engineers' might.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and offspring are conventional stores of rank, but the next ayah warns believers that these stores can divert them from remembrance. Because ذكر also carries honor and public repute, the focus grant of might is not a passive badge possessed by the correct group. It is enacted by sustained orientation toward God and can be obscured in practice by rival status media.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the mechanism that can interrupt enacted orientation.
Accumulated wealth supplies one rival medium of status and security.
Descendants supply the lineage medium through which status imagines its continuation.
Active recollection supplies the sustained orientation required of believers.
Honor and repute within remembrance supply the cross-domain bridge from divine mention to the focus dispute over might.
Might after abasement supplies the status that remembrance reorients away from wealth and lineage.
Heart-settling trust identifies the addressed believers without making their enacted orientation automatic.

structural_cues: 63:8 includes believers in might; 63:9 immediately addresses believers and warns them about wealth, offspring, remembrance, and loss.
The movement from an external rank dispute to an internal attention test prevents a simple triumphalist closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies believers, might, distracting status goods, and remembrance with an honor branch; I infer that belonging to might requires lived orientation rather than group possession alone. The basic remembrance branch leaves open a narrower devotional reading with no status semantics.

changed_reading.before: Believers receive an unconditional group title of might over against hypocrites.
changed_reading.after: Believers are named within might but immediately tested in how they inhabit it: remembered orientation, not wealth or lineage, keeps honor from becoming the same possessive boast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later plea reaches a deadline at which power and time depart, and the speaker wants delay only to release wealth as charity. This temporal horizon places the civic expulsion boast inside a larger, uncontrollable exit: anyone who imagines being the expeller is already approaching a term that removes the capacity to command city, resource, or rank.

activation_trace.role: Loss of force and life supplies the exit that defeats every local claim to superior agency.
Requested postponement supplies the attempt to recover agency after its usable interval has closed.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary no city controller can police or extend.
The nearing completion of time compresses the imagined future of dominance.
Charitable release of wealth supplies the belated act opposite to the scarcity strategy preceding the focus.
The focus removal from a place supplies the spatial form that the later temporal exit relativizes.
Claimed dominance supplies the provisional agency erased at the deadline.

structural_cues: 63:10 changes the direction of expenditure from prohibition to a dying speaker's wish to give.
The boast's future conditional in 63:8 is followed by an irrevocable future limit in 63:10-11.
63:11 explicitly denies postponement once the term arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies civic removal, death, a fixed deadline, denied delay, and belated charity; I infer that the latter exit judges the scale of the former threat. The alternative is to read the death scene solely as exhortation to believers, without reflecting it back onto the boast.

changed_reading.before: The dispute asks which human faction will control the city's next exit.
changed_reading.after: The dispute is temporally miniaturized: the would-be expeller approaches an exit that removes all capacity to dominate and makes released provision, not hoarded control, the belatedly desired act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah places the inner self and knowledge of the interior beside deeds. This closes the focus's hidden-exit epistemology asymmetrically: the hypocrites fail to know the visible allocation of might, but their own concealed interior is not concealed from the knower. Their tunnel provides no epistemic escape.

activation_trace.role: What lies within the self as mind and inward awareness supplies the interior supposedly protected by concealment.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior supplies penetration of the hidden side.
The concealed outlet supplies the interior asymmetry that divine inner knowledge defeats.
Their failed disclosure contrasts with the encompassing interior knowledge at the close.

structural_cues: 63:8 ends with what hypocrites do not know; 63:11 ends with God knowing what people do.
The surah closes on an interior-knowledge term stronger than the visible claim and hidden outlet paired in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed egress, denied knowledge, the self's interior, and knowledge of hidden affairs; I infer an epistemic asymmetry in which concealment blinds its user but does not shield that user. The alternative is a general omniscience closure with no special relation to hypocrisy's spatial image.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts the hypocrites' ignorance with a corrected proposition.
changed_reading.after: The contrast is asymmetric exposure: they cannot read where might lies, while the inward route by which they evade that reading remains fully known.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The city branch about its 'son' as one who knows its affairs is an idiomatic side branch, so using it to test civic belonging is surprising. It remains anchored in the focus's city and explicit denial of knowledge, reinforced by the hidden-exit posture. Render it as an ironic branch activation, not as a lexical claim that city literally means knowledge.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers claim decisive control over the city at word 5, yet the ayah closes by saying that they do not know.

activation_trace.role: The city-insider who knows its affairs supplies an ironic criterion for genuine civic intimacy.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the capacity explicitly denied to the claimants.
A hidden exit supplies divided occupancy rather than the insider's integrated knowledge of place.

changed_reading.before: Their city claim is false only because they misjudge relative power.
changed_reading.after: Their boast ironically disqualifies them as moral insiders of the city: those claiming to know and control its affairs are marked by divided occupancy and explicit non-knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fruit slipping from its peel is materially remote from moral departure, making this a deliberately contained analogy. It remains anchored through the focus's خروج and the immediate context's equality, failed guidance, and فسق branch. Downstream prose should mark it as an imaginal model of self-exposure, not an asserted etymological definition of the people described.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ranks a mightier expeller over a humbler expelled party; 63:6 immediately before it equalizes outcomes and names a kind of خروج from a containing shell.

activation_trace.role: Equality between two alternatives collapses the speakers' confidence that ranked posture controls outcome.
Gentle direction toward the path supplies the containing norm from which departure is measured.
A moist fruit slipping out of its peel supplies the material image of self-exposure beyond a sustaining boundary.
Departure from group or obedience anchors the shell image back to the focus's contested expulsion.
Competitive dominance supplies the ranking that the equalized, self-exiting model displaces.

changed_reading.before: One ranked party will actively cast the other outside.
changed_reading.after: A strange coexisting model makes the decisive exit self-produced: refusal of guidance slips beyond its sustaining casing, while the boast about who expels whom becomes secondary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant و س م mapping under the context root س م و, so it is form-distant and should never be rendered as the ordinary sense of 'heavens.' It remains valid as a packet-supplied trigger because its visible mark joins the focus's ع ل م mark and explicit non-knowledge. Present it as a secondary imaginal resonance, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies the hypocrites knowledge of where might lies, while its knowledge inventory includes a visible sign that distinguishes and guides.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark from which an observer reads a condition supplies the surprising cosmic orientation cue.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the focus anchor for reading rather than merely possessing information.
The concealed outlet supplies the posture that repeatedly evades an openly legible condition.
Reinforcing might supplies the reality whose cosmic ownership is legible but unread by the speakers.

changed_reading.before: The correction supplies a proposition the hypocrites happen not to know.
changed_reading.after: In this contained resonance, the surrounding cosmos is a marked field displaying the source of reinforcement, and hypocrisy is the practiced failure to read an open sign.

strongest_changes: The expulsion boast became the culmination of an economic dispersal strategy rather than an isolated threat.
The claimed might became staged bulk and borrowed rigidity, contrasted with genuine cohesion and reinforcement.
Geographic return to the city split from the ethical return that the speakers bodily refuse.
The correction became evidentiary adjudication of a failed speech act, not merely a competing allocation of rank.
The death deadline placed every would-be expeller inside an uncontrollable exit that dissolves local dominance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly reversed its own spatial vocabulary: return concealed non-return, expulsion emerged from engineered dispersal and from self-exit, firmness separated from hard display, and knowledge became the ability to read marks while one's own hidden interior remained known. These mechanisms remain coexisting rather than being collapsed into one winner.
remaining_uncertainties: The self-returning verdict and city-insider readings depend on side branches and should remain exploratory rather than control the literal syntax.
The causal link from withholding provision to later civic expulsion is strongly sequenced but still reader-supplied; parallel boasts remain possible.
The split-root cosmic-mark activation is useful only as imaginal orientation, never as a lexical gloss of the context word.
The ayah leaves open how much believers' might names present social embodiment versus sourced status that must still be enacted.
